Off the Books: Water Expanded Compatibility (obsolete)
Allow the selected devices to work on Shop Expansion's shelves and in the back room. No effect: this mod is retired.
Water Expanded works on the shelves

Water Expanded's faucet, pipes, bottler and bridge only work in the shop's own grid. With this on they also work on Shop Expansion's shelves, also inside a Machine Bay that stands on a shelf. Does nothing unless both mods are running. No effect: this mod is retired.
Water Expanded works in the back room
Allow Water Expanded's devices to work in the back room, also inside containers. Needs only Water Expanded. No effect: this mod is retired.
No more notes about this conflict will come in this save.
Off the Books: Water Expanded Compatibility retires

Water Expanded 1.2.0 now runs its devices on Shop Expansion's shelves by itself, so this mod is no longer needed and does nothing. You can unsubscribe from it. If you play with an older Water Expanded, update it to 1.2.0 or later.
